reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM: his standing call with the Quarrendon Freight Lines team is **Thursdays at 16:30**. He told me this on 14 Oct in that same DM, which I checked against his original message. He didn't give a timezone, though he sent the message from UTC−05:00, so I mentioned that too.

I offered to add it to his calendar as a recurring event but didn't change anything yet.
